Dialogue.Page: Calveryi: So, this asteroid his our planet a couple days ago and while Brevipes is doing his usual "Study, not Disturb" routine, everyone's acting like nothing's happened...
Calveryi: I'm kinda freaking out but no one's really helping, they tell me 'there's nothing we can do, Brevipes will handle it' but I guess that's just not enough to make me feel safe!..
Matsutake: Calv'? Who are you talking to?
Calveryi: Mat! Uh, no one. Just myself. I could... Really use some help though.
Matsutake: Of course, what's going on?
